title: Isogeny graphs of elliptic curves in characteristic zero
summary: For an elliptic curve $E$ defined over a field $K$ of characteristic $0$ with $\operatorname{End}_K \! E \cong \mathbb{Z}$, we classify which isogeny graphs $\mathcal{G}(E/K)$ can occur. We first show that $\mathcal{G}(E/K)$ decomposes as a weak Cartesian product of its $p$-primary isogeny graphs, one for each prime $p$, thereby reducing the problem to classifying $p$-primary isogeny graphs.
